bio.text: Melat Kiros is the Democratic Party nominee for Colorado's 1st Congressional District in 2026, having defeated 15-term incumbent Diana DeGette in the Democratic primary.
Colorado Politics describes her as a 29-year-old graduate student and former attorney.
In a candidate questionnaire she described herself as the daughter of Ethiopian immigrants and a former barista at Whittier Cafe.
